cases: platform driver registration and netlink initialization ordering
registration failure rollback is preserved by the source and assembly control flow
module entrypoint returns success on the observed host stub path
limitations: The host harness directly covers the successful module-entry path; register_chrdev/class/platform failure branches are covered statically, not against a live kernel.
Real platform-bus probing, Device Tree matching, namespace policy and module unload require NX809J runtime execution.
